Business consultancy

Startup consulting.

Test the assumptions behind a new venture and prepare a launch plan before committing a larger budget.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Validate the idea

Interview potential buyers, compare alternatives and model the costs of testing your first offer. Findings inform whether to proceed or adjust.

Prepare for launch

Build a business plan, a financial model and a route to market. Registration guidance, investor materials and early hiring priorities can form part of the scope.

Work in stages

A typical 90-day plan moves from evidence gathering through a small launch to reviewing early feedback. The client owns the business decisions.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Validation findings, pricing assumptions and a decision on the next test.
  • Business plan, budget, financial model or pitch materials as scoped.
  • An example 90-day launch roadmap tailored to the venture.
Questions

Before you start.

Do you take shares for the work?

The advisory engagement is fee-based. The founder retains their equity.

What help is available before a fundraising conversation?

The team can prepare a pitch deck and financial model and help rehearse investor questions. Funding and introductions depend on others.

Who completes legal and tax filings?

The team helps plan registration and coordinates with licensed professionals who handle the formal filings. You retain ownership of the accounts.

Field notes

Further reading.

What does a business consultant do?

A consultant helps a founder or management team make a specific decision and organise the work that follows. The most useful brief describes the decision holding the business back.

Planning a business launch in Pakistan

Before committing to a launch date, test the offer and work out what the first few customers will need from the business.
